verdict.rationale: Folk is a SaaS CRM, and asking whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only the REST API, webhooks, MCP integrations and pricing. Nothing mentions a public source repository or an open-source license, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
